## Summary

- What changed?
- Why is the change needed?

## Risk

- [ ] No customer-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Customer-facing behavior changed and was manually checked
- [ ] Worker/API behavior changed and requires deployment after merge

## Automated checks

- [ ] `PR checks / validate` passes

## Manual verification

- [ ] Main affected page/flow checked on mobile or desktop as appropriate
- [ ] Contact/Order flow checked if related
- [ ] No secret value was added to code, PR text, screenshots, or logs

## Deployment note

Describe whether the merge changes only GitHub Pages or also requires a Cloudflare Worker deployment.
